rubric: infrastructure rubric with public-app product, release, trust, privacy, feedback-loop, and rendered-UX lenses

sample.method: Public-shim manual fallback: canonical context constraints, direct 93-file Vitest baseline, release-gate replay, largest-surface inventory, contradiction searches, and premise-specific tracing through sync, ledger, advisor, bankroll, dashboard, and feedback code.

premiseLedger.baseline: Direct npm test exit 0 with 93/93 files and 642/642 assertions. Release gate remains an honest FORGE HOLD. Current tree has no Human Action Required item and no dependency/install need.
premiseLedger.releaseLens: Stable remote staging, six edge headers, historical credential remediation, exact deploy authority, Zoho/Obelisk delegation, real auth/payment/friend/capture journeys, and founder approval remain external evidence boundaries. They are explicitly excluded from repo-owned implementation.
liveContradictions: Collection merge unions remote and local rows but records no deletion tombstones, so an offline deletion can be resurrected by an older remote row.
The empty Ledger persists a +$138.60 demo row into canonical appData; every total, streak, report, tax, export, mastery, and insight consumer can treat it as realized evidence.
Promo Advisor displays model-reported confidence while the existing Brier calibration ledger is only visible elsewhere and never governs the current decision posture.
Risk radar sums exposure but does not cluster same-event, same-market, or same-book concentration; equal total stakes can therefore hide radically different downside shapes.
Friction and skip reasons are captured and counted, but no source-derived recovery plan closes the loop from repeated friction to the next safer action.

items.title: Make offline deletions converge with domain tombstones instead of resurrecting stale cloud rows
items.axis: security / sync infrastructure / data integrity / automation
items.why: The entity-aware merge always unions collection members. Removing a ledger, workflow, feedback, journal, or odds row locally leaves no durable negative fact, so an older remote member can return after reconnect. A sync receipt that says latest state was saved is not truthful if deletions are non-convergent.
evidence: src/sync.js _mergeCollection applies remote then local entries and never filters a deleted ID.
_buildEntityMeta stamps whole-domain change times but _mergeEntityAware still unions seven collection domains regardless of which side deleted an entry.
No tombstone, deletedAt, or deletion-clock contract exists in sync code or its 29 focused tests.
items.recipe: Add bounded per-domain tombstone clocks generated by diffing previous versus next collections; merge tombstones monotonically; suppress members whose entry clock does not beat the tombstone; preserve tombstones through compact and legacy tracker payloads; cap only tombstones proven older than the retention horizon; add offline delete/reconnect, edit-after-delete, malformed clock, idempotency, and cross-domain tests.

L1.recipe: Record ledger tombstones and filter stale remote rows.

L2.recipe: Cover every merged collection with monotonic clocks and convergence tests.

L3.recipe: Add bounded retention, edit-after-delete semantics, compact-payload preservation, diagnostics, and adversarial multi-device tests.

executionLog.note: L3 shipped: seven merged domains now carry monotonic tombstone clocks through compact and legacy payloads; stale remote rows stay deleted, intentional newer edits can restore, malformed clocks fail open to real evidence, and old tombstones prune only after both sides prove absence. Focused sync suites pass 38/38.

items.title: Turn historical AI calibration into a live confidence governor with an explicit abstention posture
items.axis: AI integration / feedback loop / trust / UX
items.why: PromoGrind already measures per-source Brier error, but the current Advisor card still presents the model's high/medium/low label as if it were self-sufficient. The strongest feedback system is inert at the decision boundary where it matters.
evidence: src/lib/aiCalibration.js computes Brier calibration with a ten-sample reveal threshold.
src/components/PromoAdvisorPanel.jsx renders result.confidence directly and records a prediction, but never reads summarizeCalibration.
src/lib/commandDeck.js is the only current consumer that turns calibration history into user-facing trust copy.
items.recipe: Create a pure confidence governor that combines claimed confidence, evidence grade, missing inputs, analysis source, and historical calibration without fabricating outcome probability. Emit act/verify/abstain posture, reason codes, cold-start disclosure, and a receipt. Render it beside the Advisor verdict, persist it into saved workflows, and test overconfidence, small samples, degraded calibration, rule-engine provenance, and accessibility.

L1.recipe: Show calibration context beside raw confidence.

L2.recipe: Add a pure effective-confidence and verify/abstain governor with tests.

L3.recipe: Add receipt-grade reasons, workflow persistence, cold-start semantics, adversarial calibration tests, and rendered theme/viewport verification.

executionLog.note: L3 shipped: a pure confidence governor now combines raw confidence, evidence completeness, missing inputs, provenance, and resolved Brier calibration into act/verify/abstain posture; the bounded receipt persists with workflows and a forward-only migration. Six focused governor/render tests and the 679-assertion suite pass.

items.title: Quarantine synthetic ledger examples and centralize realized-evidence truth across every derived surface
items.why: The empty-state demo button writes a profitable fake row into canonical storage. That row immediately changes total profit, today/month profit, streaks, reports, exports, tax estimates, achievements, mastery, and dashboard narrative. Labeling the note as demo does not protect derived truth.
evidence: src/components/Ledger.jsx writes id ledger-demo with profit 138.60 through syncAppData.
Ledger totals and downstream consumers use parseFloat over every row with no evidence classifier.
Historical demo rows can sync to the cloud and survive after the button is removed unless canonical truth recognizes them.
items.recipe: Create a canonical ledger-evidence module that classifies real, synthetic, and malformed rows, summarizes only realized evidence, and reports excluded counts. Replace the persisted demo with an inert preview. Migrate Ledger, insights, mastery, achievements, dashboard summaries, exports, and share/report surfaces to the canonical selector; preserve visible user control for deleting old synthetic rows; add no-fabricated-profit and cross-consumer invariant tests.

L1.recipe: Stop persisting new demo rows and filter known historical demos from totals.

L2.recipe: Centralize classification and migrate primary summaries/exports.

L3.recipe: Migrate all derived consumers, add exclusion disclosure and cleanup, cross-consumer truth tests, legal-copy ratchet, and rendered verification.

executionLog.note: L3 shipped: synthetic/demo rows are quarantined before load and tombstoned against cloud resurrection; one canonical realized-evidence selector now governs Ledger, dashboard, insights, portfolio, mastery, achievements, streaks, and PromoGraph. The empty-state example is inert and the UI discloses quarantined evidence.

items.title: Model concentration clusters so equal exposure totals cannot hide unequal downside
items.axis: feature depth / decision safety / gamification restraint / UX
items.why: The current radar treats three independent $50 positions like three legs tied to one event. Total dollars are identical, but correlated event/book/market failure has a materially different risk shape. PromoGrind's calm operator promise needs concentration context, not only volume.
evidence: src/lib/bankrollStress.js totalExposure is a scalar stake sum.
src/dashboard/today.js exposes exposure and exposurePct but no concentration dimension.
src/lib/promoConflict.js detects promo workflow collisions, not open-position portfolio clusters.
items.recipe: Build a deterministic exposure-cluster analyzer with explicit and conservative inferred keys, confidence labels, unknown-data handling, largest-cluster and concentration ratios, and no claim of probabilistic independence. Feed it into the risk radar, discipline detail, and stress preview; add same-event/book/market, missing metadata, hedge-pair, and false-correlation tests; render a compact disclosure that routes users to review positions rather than encouraging action.

L1.recipe: Group open stakes by explicit event key and show largest cluster.

L2.recipe: Add conservative inference, confidence, and risk-radar integration.

L3.recipe: Add hedge-aware semantics, unknown-data disclosure, discipline/stress integration, adversarial tests, and rendered verification.

executionLog.note: L3 shipped: deterministic event, event-market, and book clusters expose gross concentration, confidence, unknown metadata, and declared-hedge posture without inferring independence or net protection. Risk Radar, discipline, stress context, and Bet Tracker event capture are wired and adversarial tests pass.

items.title: Convert repeated execution friction into a source-derived recovery plan instead of a passive count
items.why: PromoGrind asks users why they skipped or struggled, then mostly leaves the answer in a histogram. The closed loop should translate repeated terms, timing, line movement, book, and bankroll friction into a bounded next action while avoiding generic AI advice.
evidence: src/components/TrackInsights.jsx renders those rows as counts.
No recovery/intervention builder consumes the reason aggregates; workflow scoring only subtracts points for friction.
items.recipe: Create a deterministic friction recovery engine keyed to canonical reason codes, minimum evidence thresholds, recency, and route-safe actions. Surface one primary recovery card plus evidence count and why-now copy in Track and Today; make unknown reasons fall back to review rather than invented advice; test thresholding, ties, recency, route integrity, no-profit ranking, and rendered mobile/theme states.

L1.recipe: Map the top repeated reason to one static recovery action.

L2.recipe: Add thresholds, recency, evidence copy, and Track integration.

L3.recipe: Add Today integration, route-safe action contracts, tie/unknown/no-profit invariants, tests, and rendered verification.

executionLog.note: L3 shipped: repeated recent canonical skip/friction reasons now produce one deterministic, route-safe recovery plan ranked by frequency and recency rather than profit. Track and Today render the bounded why-now action; threshold, tie, unknown, route, and profit-independence tests pass.

secondOrder.note: Recovery replay found the new pixel auditor reading nonexistent per-channel Sharp entropy and falsely failing all 20 captures. The verifier now consumes aggregate entropy with a guarded compatibility fallback; all 20 unique desktop/mobile dark/light captures pass dimensions, opacity, non-blankness, tonal range, and theme-pair separation.

The complete launch gate caught visual QA writing a fresh canonical receipt while leaving release parity stale. Shared artifact preparation and atomic writers now let the visual producer refresh parity in the same transaction; focused compiler and freshness checks pass.
